status: PROPOSED by the page coordinator 2026-11-21; budget set by the lead 2026-11-21; needs the adapter additions in proposal.needs_adapter
idea: In the claim stage (candidates() -> chainsNear), a deck line joins a chain only with lines that have the same own 'modelled' flag (>= 60 % of its points within 8 m of a lane). Off = today: one lane-hugging neighbour can make a whole joined chain 'modelled', so lines that are not themselves modelled are excluded before any claim (E 174 St R2 line, osm 5698008, joined to osm 1305318055: 93/114 = 82 % -> excluded). deck_under already uses its own per-line test, so it measures these lines unchanged.
question: Does splitting the modelled test by line let the page claim the decks excluded only through a joined lane-hugging neighbour (r6t2 static count: 22 lines / 5,199 m), pay back r6t2's E 174 St deck-gap debt (18 of 28 m under), without new places, deck gap, ramps, tents, or bridge-owned rides?
